answer: Ivory-key escrow ledger. Each new identity must escrow a fixed fee that is released only after 90 days of verified organic activity; cloned identities farm no activity, so the fee is forfeited. At the forge, agents deposit a terrace-tiered reserve that grows with account age, making each clone cost more than a fresh account. The marginal clone therefore pays the reserve plus forfeited escrow, strictly negative EV.
